description: This file defines a custom exception class 'SubscriptionProtocolErrorException' used in the Eclipse Ditto project to handle subscription protocol errors related to long periods of no interaction. It extends 'DittoRuntimeException' and provides methods for creating instances from causes or JSON objects, along with a builder class for fluent construction.

classes.name: SubscriptionProtocolErrorException
classes.description: Custom exception class representing subscription protocol errors in the Ditto framework.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: Inner static class providing a fluent API for constructing instances of 'SubscriptionProtocolErrorException'.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of the exception from a Throwable cause and Ditto headers.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder instance for creating exceptions.

methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a JSON object and Ditto headers.
